title: Half the sheep to bed
_map: Half of the flock (Y1–2). Big idea: finding a fraction of a number. Creative: half the sheep go to the barn: how many? A quarter? Make up his own.
_story: Bedtime on the farm. Half of the 12 sheep go into the barn. Then a quarter of them go to the top field. Ismaeel shares them out, then invents his own fraction puzzle.
_stepChain: halves of shapes (halves) → half of a group: share into 2 equal groups → half of 12 is 6 → a quarter: share into 4 → a quarter of 12 is 3 → Steve halves 12 into 5 and 7 → invent one

talk.ask: How do you find half of 12 sheep?
talk.goodAnswer: share them into 2 equal groups: 6 in each.

talk.ask: How do you find a quarter?
talk.goodAnswer: share into 4 equal groups: a quarter of 12 is 3.

handsOn: Get 12 Lego bricks. Find half by sharing into 2 piles, then a quarter by sharing into 4 piles. Can you find a third?

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Yawn! It's bedtime on the farm! Half of my 12 sheep sleep in the barn, and the other half sleep in the field. How many go in the barn?
Half means sharing into 2 equal groups. Pick how many sheep go in each group, then tap the hammer.
Half of 12 is 6! Now let's find a quarter. Share the 12 sheep into 4 equal groups. Each group has 3. A quarter of 12 is 3!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I put 5 sheep in the barn, and 7 in the field. That's half and half! Goodnight, sheep!

question.onRight: Yes, you caught him! Halves must be equal: 6 and 6.

0.mistake: thinks any split into 2 groups is halves
0.hint: Are the two groups the same size?
0.say: 5 and 7 aren't the same, so they aren't halves! Half of 12 is 6 and 6.

narration.text: Now you make a puzzle! Pick a number of animals, and ask a grown-up to find half, or a quarter. Then check their answer by sharing!

rule.text: Half: share into 2. Quarter: share into 4.
rule.ask: How do you find a quarter of a group? Say it out loud! Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: To find half of a group, share it into 2 equal groups. To find a quarter, share it into 4.

bonus.prompt: Bonus! Three quarters of 12 sheep. How many?
bonus.onRight: Yes! A quarter is 3. So three quarters is 3, 6, 9!

0.hint: 3 is one quarter. We want three of those quarters.
0.say: One quarter of 12 is 3. Three quarters is three of those groups! 3, 6, 9.

2.mistake: confused the number of parts with the answer
2.hint: 4 is how many groups. How many sheep are in 3 of the groups?
2.say: Share 12 into 4 groups of 3. Three of those groups make 9!
